thought.text: The three dev servers are building. Let me wait for them to become ready and verify the frontends respond.

action.command: sleep 180; tail -25 /tmp/justserve.log; echo "=== endpoints ==="; for h in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --resolve "$h.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://$h.urbo.localhost/"); echo "$h -> $code"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "sleep 180; tail -25 /tmp/justserve.log; echo \"=== endpoints ===\"; for h in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" --resolve \"$h.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1\" \"http://$h.urbo.localhost/\"); echo \"$h -> $code\"; done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check dev servers readiness"}
